fields.Lock: Locked floor hatch behind Omotola’s counter. DC 20 Sleight of Hand without a key. Omotola also carries a separately named Glitter Gala Stockroom Key for this hatch.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by Thomas C. Quirkilious in the Chromatic Scale. His own stockroom key opens a different lock.
